mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a waxing gibbous moon. If you look to the northwest near Verona High School at 5:49 PM, you can catch the space station for three minutes as it travels toward the northeast near Home Depot, visible low near the horizon.

Please note that all city buildings will be closed November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Additionally, refuse and recycling collection scheduled for that Thursday will be moved to Friday, and the recycling center will be closed.
There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with live music today at both Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, followed by more performances tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident on November 9, an officer conducted a traffic stop on USH 18/151 where the driver was arrested for an O W I, third offence.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
